findings.explanation: HOL4 saves only HD (h::t) = h. The definition takes the PRIMREC path (Defn.sml:1182, non_wfrec_defn), which uses Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition and new_specification, so no primitive ARB equation is made and HD [] is unspecified. I found no saved theorem equating HD [] with ARB; bool$ARB is an undefined constant, so the two are unrelated. The Lean definition adds the clause HD [] = ARB, so Lean proves HD [] = ARB by rfl. As a consequence EL n [] = ARB also holds, and HD [] becomes equal to every other function value filled in with ARB, e.g. THE none.
findings.repair:
opaque HD_NIL (α : Type) [Nonempty α] : α

def HD [Nonempty α] : List α → α
  | h :: _ => h
  | [] => HD_NIL α
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.ListLib

example {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : CmlTS.HD ([] : List α) = CmlTS.ARB := rfl

example {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : CmlTS.HD ([] : List α) = CmlTS.THE (none : Option α) := rfl
